beforeImage.name: Unison Energy
beforeImage.description: Unison Energy designs, builds, owns, operates, and maintains behind-the-meter microgrids for commercial and industrial customers. Its customer base includes data centers, healthcare facilities, campuses, industrial sites, and other users that require resilient onsite energy infrastructure. The operating model is asset-heavy and contract-based, with Unison providing energy-as-a-service rather than selling equipment only. Company materials describe the platform as fully integrated across development, construction, ownership, and operations. Tiger completed its acquisition-backed growth investment in 2024 and is the current sponsor identified in public materials.

milestones.event: Tiger described Unison as a fully integrated energy-as-a-service microgrid platform.
Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III closed its growth capital investment and acquisition of Unison Energy.

afterImage.name: Unison Energy
afterImage.description: Unison Energy, LLC develops, finances, builds, owns, operates and maintains behind-the-meter microgrids and distributed-energy systems for commercial and industrial customers across North America. Its primary model uses long-term energy-service agreements and project SPVs, while the company also supports customer-owned EPC, operations-and-maintenance and hybrid structures; not every system is therefore owned by Unison. The platform serves healthcare, data-center, industrial, hospitality, logistics and other resilience-sensitive facilities using combined heat and power, controls, solar, batteries and thermal systems. At Tiger's June 2024 entry, public materials described approximately 30 operating or signed-ESA projects and about 26 MW installed; a current aggregate scale is not publicly disclosed. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III acquired control through Fund III AIV U LP on June 17, 2024 from American Infrastructure Funds/AIM Universal and Hunt Companies. Exact percentages and consideration were not disclosed, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
